tools.name: contact_check
tools.description: Check whether a cold or unsolicited marketing email to one recipient is allowed under UK PECR and GDPR, US CAN-SPAM, Canadian CASL, German UWG or French rules. Use it before the first email to a new contact, one call per address. Returns the verdict, confidence, the rule quoted with its source, the

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a Precleared receipt by its id (cc_rcpt_...) to show what was checked, when, and the verdict, with the hashes, Ed25519 signature and public key needed to verify it. Use it when a person or an audit asks for proof of a check.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contact_check · Private data: contact_check · Public sink: contact_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contact_check · Private data: contact_check · Public sink: contact_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
